# The trading pack

*Trading* · version 1.0.0 · code `TRDS`

## What it is

Trades in 125 products across rates, FX, credit, equity, commodities, inflation, fixed income, securities financing, money markets
and structured products, as three booking systems (ENDUR, CALYPSO, MUREX) write them: one common trade shape in UPPER_SNAKE names,
47 top-level attributes, `LEGS[]` with an `INDEX` and `CASH_FLOWS[]` (each flow with `RESETS[]`), and `EVENTS[]`. The pack also
derives pages of trades by counterparty, portfolio, legal entity and index (the `trade-pages` connector).

## Data structures

Every kind the pack owns, read from its manifest, its samples and its Sutras: how its ids look, its fields (type, an example, what it means), its nested lists and the fields that link to other kinds. A path `A[].B` is field `B` of every element of list `A`.

### `trade`

**Trade** · mnemonic `TRD` · read through connector `trade-endur`.

**Id:** field `TRADE_ID`; pattern `^(MX|CLY)-\d+$`; for example `1000001`.

Fields, from 765 sample documents:

| Field | Type | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `SOURCE_SYSTEM` | string | `ENDUR` | Source |
| `SOURCE_UPDATE_TIME` | timestamp | `2026-09-30T18:30:00Z` | When the booking system last changed the trade |
| `TRADE_DATE` | date | `2025-06-20` | Trade date |
| `INPUT_DATE` | date | `2024-04-19` | The day the trade was entered |
| `TRADE_ID` | string | `1000001` | The document's id; link to `trade` |
| `TRADE_STATUS` | string | `VALIDATED` | Life-cycle status (VALIDATED, NEW, AMENDED, MATURED, CANCELLED) |
| `TRADE_ACTION` | string | `NEW` | The last action on the trade (empty when none) |
| `TRADE_VERSION` | string | `1` | The booking system's version number of the trade |
| `TRANSACTION_ID` | string | `700000000` | The booking system's transaction number |
| `PACKAGE_ID` | null |  | The package the trade belongs to (null when none) |
| `QUANTITY` | number | `72000.0` | Quantity or notional in the trade's unit |
| `PRICE` | number | `2332.9131` | Price |
| `BUY_SELL_CODE` | string | `S` | B (bought) or S (sold) |
| `PRODUCT_TYPE` | string | `ComSwap` | The product type; selects the trade's Sutra (one per product type) |
| `PRODUCT_SUB_TYPE` | string | `ENGY-SWAP` | The product sub-type; selects the panels shown |
| `PRODUCT_GROUP` | string | `FX` | Product group, e.g. FX |
| `PRODUCT_SUB_GROUP` | string | `linear` | Product sub-group, e.g. linear |
| `OPTION_TYPE` | string | `Call` | Call or Put, for options |
| `STRIKE_PRICE` | number | `158.79394` | Strike, for options |
| `COUNTERPARTY` | string | `CP-HARBORPT` | The counterparty's id (core pack); link to `counterparty` |
| `COUNTERPARTY_UEN` | string | `UEN0100259` | The counterparty's unique entity number |
| `COUNTERPARTY_COUNTRY_OF_RISK` | string | `US` | The counterparty's country of risk (ISO alpha-2) |
| `ORIGINAL_COUNTERPARTY` | string | `CP-HALCYON` | The counterparty before a novation or clearing; link to `counterparty` |
| `ORIGINAL_COUNTERPARTY_UEN` | string | `UEN0100222` | Its unique entity number |
| `INTERNAL_EXTERNAL_CODE` | string | `External` | Internal (between the bank's own books) or External |
| `TRANSIT` | string | `00107` | The branch transit number |
| `LEGAL_ENTITY` | string | `LE-NY` | The bank's legal entity that booked it (core pack); link to `legal-entity` |
| `PORTFOLIO` | string | `BOOK-COMM-2` | The book (portfolio) id (core pack); link to `book` |
| `TRADER_ID` | string | `TRDR-FROSSI` | The trader's id (core pack); link to `trader` |
| `TRADER_FIRST_NAME` | string | `F.` | The trader's first name or initial |
| `TRADER_LAST_NAME` | string | `Rossi` | The trader's last name |
| `START_DATE` | date | `2025-08-01` | Start (effective) date |
| `MATURITY_DATE` | date | `2028-07-31` | Maturity |
| `REGISTRY_DELIVERY_DATE` | date | `2026-06-01` | Registry delivery date, for emissions and registered products |
| `CURRENCY` | string | `USD` | The trade's currency |
| `DELIVERY_VERSUS_PAYMENT` | string | `NO` | YES when settled delivery versus payment |
| `STRATEGY` | null |  | The trading strategy (null when none) |
| `INTERNAL_TRADING_STRATEGY` | null |  | The internal strategy code (null when none) |
| `NY_CURVE_FLAG` | null |  | The booking system's New York curve flag (null when not set) |
| `VAULT_LOCATION_ALLOCATION` | string | `Vault Toronto A` | Vault the metal is allocated to, for precious metals |
| `PRECIOUS_METAL_FLAG` | string | `Y` | Y for a precious-metals trade |
| `TT_GROUP` | string | `DESK-FX` | The desk the trade is grouped under for transfer pricing; link to `desk` |
| `TT_BOOK` | string | `BOOK-FX-3` | The book for transfer pricing; link to `book` |
| `LEASE_PERPETUITY_FLAG` | string | `Y` | Y for a perpetual metal lease |
| `SETTLEMENT_DATE` | date | `2024-04-22` | Settlement date |
| `LEGS` | list of objects |  | The legs, each with its index and cash flows (and their resets) |
| `EVENTS` | list of objects |  | Cash and life-cycle events, each naming its leg by LEG_ID |

Nested structures:

| Path | Fields |
|---|---|
| `LEGS[]` | `LEG_ID` (string), `LEG_TYPE` (string), `LEG_ECONOMIC_TYPE` (string), `CURRENCY` (string), `LEASE_CURRENCY` (string), `FLOAT_SPREAD` (string or number), `PRICE_UNIT` (string), `NOTIONAL` (number), `DISCOUNT_INDEX` (string), `SPOT_CONVERSION_FACTOR` (string), `PHYSICAL_LOCATION_NAME` (string), `INDEX_LOCATION_NAME` (string), `RESET_FIXING_SHIFT` (string), `RESET_HOLIDAY_SCHEDULE` (string), `RESET_CONVENTION` (string), `EMISSIONS_VINTAGE_MIN` (null), `EMISSIONS_VINTAGE_MAX` (null), `EMISSIONS_VINTAGE_DELIVERY_TYPE` (null), `SETTLEMENT_TYPE` (string), `NY_CURVE_FLAG` (null), `NUM_RRDC_REC` (null), `NUM_PROFILE_REC` (string), `DAILY_VOLUME` (string), `INDEX` (object), `CASH_FLOWS` (list of objects): The leg's periods: each with its dates, notional, rate or price, and its resets. |
| `LEGS[].INDEX` | `NAME` (string): The benchmark a floating leg is set by., `GROUP` (string), `SUB_GROUP` (string) |
| `LEGS[].CASH_FLOWS[]` | `FLOW_ID` (string), `FLOW_TYPE` (string), `NOTIONAL` (number), `RATE` (string or number), `FLOAT_SPREAD` (string or number), `START_DATE` (date), `END_DATE` (date), `PAYMENT_DATE` (date), `RATE_DETERMINATION_DATE` (date), `FIRST_RESET_DATE` (date), `LAST_RESET_DATE` (date), `STRIKE_PRICE` (number), `RESETS` (list or list of objects) |
| `LEGS[].CASH_FLOWS[].RESETS[]` | `RESET_ID` (string), `ACCRUAL` (number), `START_DATE` (date), `END_DATE` (date), `RESET_DATE` (date), `ACCRUAL_START_DATE` (date), `ACCRUAL_END_DATE` (date), `RATE` (string or number) |
| `EVENTS[]` | `LEG_ID` (string), `EVENT_ID` (string), `EVENT_NUMBER` (integer), `EVENT_TYPE` (string), `PAYMENT_TYPE` (string), `EVENT_DATE` (date), `AMOUNT` (number), `CURRENCY` (string), `SEQUENCE_NUMBER` (integer), `VAULT_LOCATION_ALLOCATION` (null), `NY_CURVE_FLAG` (null) |

Links: `COUNTERPARTY` → `counterparty`, `LEGAL_ENTITY` → `legal-entity`, `ORIGINAL_COUNTERPARTY` → `counterparty`, `PORTFOLIO` → `book`, `TRADER_ID` → `trader`, `TRADE_ID` → `trade`, `TT_BOOK` → `book`, `TT_GROUP` → `desk`.

### `counterparty-trades`

**Counterparty trades (derived from trades)** · mnemonic `CTRD` · read through connector `trade-pages`.

About: Trades of a counterparty, derived from the trades of every source system.

**Id:** set by its connector (no samples ship).

No samples ship: documents are read live from its connector `trade-pages` (plugin `derived`). The fields its screens show:

| Field | Shown as |
|---|---|
| `AMOUNT` | Amount |
| `CURRENCY` | Currency |
| `EVENT_DATE` | Date |
| `LAST_MATURITY` | Last maturity |
| `MATURITY_DATE` | Maturity |
| `NOTIONAL` | Notional (all currencies) |
| `PRODUCT_TYPE` | Product |
| `SOURCE_SYSTEM` | Source |
| `TRADE_COUNT` | Trades |

| `book-desk` | `portfolio-trades` | A book's desk: its trades; a click opens the trade's cash flows under its row, with the counterparty and its credit limit beside. |
| `counterparty-trades` | `counterparty-trades` | Every trade with a counterparty, from every source system: its trades (every status, a status filter), upcoming payments, notional by product type and index, maturities, payments by month. |
| `index-trades` | `index-trades` | Every trade with a leg on an index (the first leg that names one): its trades (every status, a status filter), upcoming payments, notional by product type and index, maturities, payments by month. |
| `legal-entity-trades` | `legal-entity-trades` | Every trade a legal entity of the bank booked, from every source system: its trades (every status, a status filter), upcoming payments, notional by product type and index, maturities, payments by month. |
| `portfolio-trades` | `portfolio-trades` | Every trade of a portfolio (book), from every source system: its trades (every status, a status filter), upcoming payments, notional by product type and index, maturities, payments by month. |

## Data sources and licences

| Source | Licence | Internal only | Used for |
|---|---|---|---|
| Synthetic sample data (tools/packgen/banking) | Proprietary (part of Drishti); fictitious names and figures | no | every document in samples/ and the demo lake |

Every kind's data contract (each column: type, key, example, links) and where its data comes from (an external source and its refresh script, a generator of synthetic data, or a Drishti engine) are in the guide, [guides/trading.md](guides/trading.md): *Data contracts* and *Data retrieval*.

## Enabling and dependencies

Builds on the packs `core`, `market-data`.

The connectors it brings (written once to `config/connectors/<name>.yaml`, then the site's own):

| Connector | Plugin | Kinds | Enabled |
|---|---|---|---|
| `trade-endur` | `delta` | `trade` | `${DRISHTI_LAKE_ENABLED:true}` |
| `trade-calypso` | `delta` | `trade` | `${DRISHTI_LAKE_ENABLED:true}` |
| `trade-murex` | `delta` | `trade` | `${DRISHTI_LAKE_ENABLED:true}` |
| `trading-stream` | `kafka` | `trade` | `${DRISHTI_STREAM_TRADING:false}` |
| `trade-pages` | `derived` | `counterparty-trades`, `portfolio-trades`, `legal-entity-trades`, `index-trades` | on |

Settings (environment variables) its connectors read: `DRISHTI_CACHE_RESET_AT`, `DRISHTI_CACHE_ROOT`, `DRISHTI_DELTA_ROOT`, `DRISHTI_KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP`, `DRISHTI_LAKE_ENABLED`, `DRISHTI_STREAM_CACHE_GB`, `DRISHTI_STREAM_DISK_CACHE`, `DRISHTI_STREAM_STALE_AFTER`, `DRISHTI_STREAM_TRADING`, `DRISHTI_TRADING_TOPIC`.

## Refreshing the data

The pack's files are written by `tools/packgen/banking/make_docs.py`; its `--check` fails when the committed files differ from what it would write.
